about: What a server gets when a profile is written to it with a per-server leave-out list. order: the enabled mods in load order. left: the ids left out. workshop: a mod's Workshop item (absent: a local mod). maps: the profile's map order. mapsOf: a mod's map folders. Rules: Mods= is order without left (load order kept). WorkshopItems= is each kept mod's item once, in first-kept order; an item goes only when no kept mod comes from it. Map= is maps without the folders only left-out mods bring (a folder a kept mod also brings stays; maps no mod brings, like the game's own, stay); but when no kept mod brings a map it is [] (the writer then leaves Map= as it is), unless left-out mods brought maps, then just ["Muldraugh, KY"] so theirs go. needsLeftOut: [kept id, the left-out id it requires] for each direct requirement in left, in order. clientSide: mods whose requirements, followed through installed mods, reach Viewpoint or ZombieBuddy (not those two). Both the app (server.rs lines_for) and the game (PZMMModScreen.lua K.serverLists / K.needsLeftOut / K.clientSide) must give exactly these.
